Early Dismissals & Closures

This is a list of early dismissals and the cancellation of extracurricular and after-school activities that have been issued for Monday, June 8, 2026:

Madison County

Madison County Schools will operate on a two-hour delay on Monday due to potential flooding and hazardous road conditions.

While traditional classes are not currently in session, this delay may impact summer learning programs, student activities, district operations and transportation services. Buses will run two hours later than their normal schedule.
